reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001192 (the melody read from 001192a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Griffith Hugh Jones's dates (1849–1919) are from https://biography.wales/article/s-JONE-HUG-1849 (JONES, GRIFFITH HUGH (Gutyn Arfon; 1849 - 1919), musician; born January 1849, Llanberis; died 26 July 1919; wrote the tune Llef); https://hymnary.org/tune/llef_jones (LLEF, G. H. Arfon, Griffith Hugh Jones, 1849-1919); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2010117421 (Arfon, G. H. (Griffith Hugh), 1849-1919); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001192a.nwc).
